acceptance.given: The repository contains the frozen A07 requirement specifying exactly three primary examples in typical, boundary, error order.

oracle.expected: During static contract evaluation, the declared primary example sequence is exactly [typical, boundary, error].
forbidden: The primary examples appear in any other order.
Supplemental reference examples are counted as members of the primary sequence.
oracle.observable: The ordered primary example declarations in the skill-authoring standard or its normative policy artifact.

acceptance.then: The primary example declarations are inspected and their sequence is checked against the required order.
acceptance.when: When primary examples are authored or validated; evaluate the declared artifact during the static contract check, before package runtime behavior is considered.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A static contract assertion over the declared primary example sequence fails when it is not exactly typical, boundary, error, while excluding supplemental examples.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the A07 primary example order explicit and verify the declared sequence as a static contract; supplemental examples do not change that sequence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No runtime state or schema changes; reverting the static A07 ordering check restores prior contract evaluation.

slice_hint.state_transition: Primary examples being authored or validated -> static evaluation establishes whether their declared order is typical, boundary, error.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A static contract check observes the declared primary sequence and determines that it is exactly typical, boundary, error; supplemental examples remain outside that sequence.
